messages:
Amelia (sec): Hey folks — onboarding a customer who wants envelope encryption using their GCP KMS key for Private deployments. Need guidance on the recommended SA pattern, minimum IAM bindings, and rotation/audit expectations. Do we ask them to create an SA for us to impersonate or grant perms directly on the cryptoKey?
Samir Patel: Prefer the least-privilege approach: customer creates a dedicated service account in their project, then grants that SA cryptoKey encrypt/decrypt on the specific cryptoKey (not project-wide). We then either impersonate that SA from our control plane or have their infra use Workload Identity to give the runtime identity the ability to impersonate. Avoid long-lived JSON keys.
Maria Gomez: +1. Important details: put the key in a customer-owned keyRing in the same region as the deployment to avoid cross-region egress. Do NOT grant roles/cloudkms.admin at the project level. Give only roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the specific resource path: projects/PROJECT/locations/LOCATION/keyRings/KEYRING/cryptoKeys/KEY.
Samir Patel: Example commands for the binding we recommend to the customer (they run in their project):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts create redwood-private-kms-sa --display-name="redwood private kms"
# bind only to the specific cryptoKey
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding \
  projects/$PROJECT/locations/$LOCATION/keyRings/$KEYRING/cryptoKeys/$KEY \
  --member="serviceAccount:redwood-private-kms-sa@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```
Samir Patel: If our control plane needs to call KMS directly, customer can grant our control plane service account the iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator role on the redwood-private-kms-sa so we can impersonate. Or better: customer uses workload identity federation / workload identity pools to avoid cross-project SA keys.
Liam Chen: On rotation: use Cloud KMS automatic rotation for the key (we recommend <= 90d depending on compliance). Cloud KMS handles new versions; make sure the deployment fetching ciphertexts knows to use key versions properly — we should design envelope decryption to accept multiple keyVersions and try latest first. To set rotation:
```
gcloud kms keys update $KEY --location=$LOCATION --keyring=$KEYRING --next-rotation-time="2026-06-01T00:00:00Z" --rotation-period="2592000s" # 30d example
```
Maria Gomez: Also recommend the customer enable Cloud Audit Logs (Data Access) for Cloud KMS and sink logs to their secure project (BigQuery/GCS/Logging sink) with at least the retention their compliance requires. We need those logs for any key access audit and incident forensics.
security-bot: NOTE: For Cloud KMS, enable DATA_ACCESS audit logs (admin activity is on by default). Verify via: https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/audit
Amelia (sec): What about access to key metadata vs decrypt/encrypt? Do we need separate roles for listing keyVersions?
Samir Patel: Listing key metadata is typically covered by roles/cloudkms.viewer or specific IAM on the keyRing. But if you only give cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the cryptoKey, that is usually enough for runtime ops. Avoid granting viewer broadly.
Liam Chen: For Private (on-prem/VPC) customers who can't do Workload Identity, if they insist on JSON keyfiles, document that these must be rotated often (short TTL) and stored in their secret manager. We should also limit what that SA can do elsewhere.
Amelia (sec): OK actions: 1) Ask customer to create SA and bind roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on specific cryptoKey, 2) Enable Cloud KMS Data Access logs and add sink, 3) Set rotation policy (we'll recommend 90d by default). Samir -> reach out to customer infra. Maria -> docs snippet for onboarding checklist.
devex-bot: Created a short onboarding snippet: https://internal.redwood.dev/kms-onboard (template + sample gcloud commands). I can open a PR for the public docs.
Samir Patel: I'll message the customer template today and request the IAM binding and audit-sink details.
Amelia (sec): Perfect, thanks. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup:
security-bot: AUDIT_LOG_CHECK: ensure sinks are configured before first key use.
Amelia (sec): Filing a quick ticket to track this flow and confirm when keys & logs are ready.
